description: The 'unused_plugins' dataset provides comprehensive information about plugins that are not currently in use within a system. This dataset is particularly useful for developers and project managers who need to track plugin usage, development status, and other metadata. Each entry in the dataset represents a unique plugin, identified by a unique ID and a human-readable label. The dataset includes details such as the version of the plugin, the author or contributors, and tags that categorize the plugin for easier searching and filtering. Additionally, it provides a description of the plugin's functionality and potential use cases. The dataset also indicates whether a plugin is still in development, its total usage count, and whether it is a built-in plugin. A URL is provided for each plugin, linking to a summary page for more detailed information. This dataset can be used to identify plugins that are underutilized or in development, helping to optimize resource allocation and improve project efficiency.
shortDesc: Dataset of unused plugins with details on usage and development status.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each plugin, key for tracking.

columns.name: label
columns.comment: Human-readable name of the plugin, aids recognition.

columns.name: code_env_name
columns.comment: Name of the code environment associated with the plugin.

columns.name: version
columns.comment: Current version of the plugin, important for updates.

columns.name: author
columns.comment: Creator or maintainer of the plugin, indicates responsibility.

columns.name: tags
columns.comment: Keywords associated with the plugin, useful for categorization.

columns.name: description
columns.comment: Detailed explanation of the plugin's functionality.

columns.name: plugin_used_in_projectkeys
columns.comment: List of project keys where the plugin is used.

columns.name: isDev
columns.comment: Indicates if the plugin is in development, boolean value.

columns.name: total_usages
columns.comment: Number of times the plugin has been used, usage metric.

columns.name: is_built_in_plugin
columns.comment: Indicates if the plugin is built-in, boolean value.

columns.name: url
columns.comment: Web link to the plugin's summary or documentation.
